verdict.summary: Round 7 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The diagnostic remains confined to the failed-parse path, preserves and returns the rejected SPARQL byte-for-byte, and cannot affect execution. The bounded hint count and candidate count, deterministic edit-distance ranking, lexical-context skipping, deduplication, and keyword-table drift guard are coherent with the documented behavior. The public error-contract tests exercise the real canary path, verify non-application, cover failures without hints, and reproduce the Unicode/escaped/dotted prefixed-name regressions from earlier rounds. Documentation accurately frames the feature as an unmeasured, optional diagnostic rather than a repair or efficacy claim. With round 6 also having no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
